checks.message: Provisional boundary status, precision and replacement rule are disclosed; it is not called official.
All three key areas remain provisional constraints and are unsuitable for precise redline claims.
Twelve polygons share cut lines, are non-overlapping, and cover the submitted boundary.
Static HTML uses only inline CSS and local figures, with no remote or active resources.
Proposal maps design judgments to sources, standards, depth items, geometry, metrics and assumptions.
Twelve scenarios include minimized data and mandatory human review; four are clearly marked industry tests.
No external imagery, fonts, trademarks or remote assets are redistributed.
Relay Receipt schema is valid Draft 2020-12 JSON Schema and the synthetic SC-04 example validates against it.
The one synthetic sandbox slice is structurally reproducible and explicitly carries null performance results; it is not deployment evidence.
Ten asset classes state source, generation method, redistributed content and restrictions.

All 28 A3 pages and 6 A0 boards across Chinese and English were rasterized and inspected through contact sheets plus original-resolution spot checks; no clipping, overlap or blank page was observed. This is visual preflight, not professional acceptance.

Chinese and English visual/report pages were checked at 1440 px and 390 px: no page-level horizontal overflow, remote resources or console errors; skip links receive focus, mobile tables scroll, and selected text/background pairs measured at least 4.73:1. No real-user, assistive-technology or field test is claimed.
Missing controls are explicitly unknown rather than inferred from design geometry.
